description: Windows CLI for cleaning caches, uninstalling applications, optimizing the system, analyzing disk usage, and checking live status.
notes: Tracks the separate official Windows CLI release (V$version-windows), not the macOS release series.
Scoop extracts the ZIP directly and does not run the bundled install.ps1. The verified CLI entry point is mo.exe; analyze.exe and status.exe are included under bin as supporting tools.
Use Scoop to update this installation. Do not run the bundled installer script over the Scoop-managed copy.
